messages:
maya_sec: Quick sync — sprint gate for audit logs + KMS/HSM handoff is tomorrow. Need confirmed owners for fieldwork artifacts, runbook snippets, and an evidence snapshot. Who can own ingest backfill and who will take HSM attestation?

alex_sre: I can own the ingest backfill (alex). Targeting Wed EOD. Will open a PR for the backfill script and include a small runbook. I need the test manifest from platform to validate ordering.

sam_platform: I’ll coordinate the test manifest (sam). Will attach it to RW-452 once I get staging creds. @lina_pm can you confirm staging access for the service account?

lina_pm: Confirmed — I can approve access. Quick checklist for me to sign off: 1) manifest attached to RW-452, 2) evidence snapshot path, 3) rollback/timeout window. I’ll comment on the ticket when done.

audit-bot: Reminder: fieldwork checklist v2 uploaded — https://redwood-internal/doc/audit-checklist-v2 :memo:

maya_sec: Thanks. Alex — please include a 2–3 line runbook snippet in that PR showing the backfill invocation and expected artifact outputs. Sam — paste the manifest link to RW-452 and call out any SA roles needed. Lina — we need a KMS policy snapshot for staging by EOD.

alex_sre: Adding runbook snippet to PR now. Example command I’ll include:

```bash
# run ingest backfill for audit logs (dry-run first)
./scripts/audit_backfill.sh --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-12 --dry-run
# apply when validated:
./scripts/audit_backfill.sh --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-12
```

sam_platform: Manifest attached to RW-452: https://redwood-internal/tickets/RW-452/manifest.json. Note: service account needs roles/logging.viewer + roles/storage.objectAdmin to read test logs and write artifacts — added TODO in ticket. :thumbsup:

lina_pm: KMS policy snapshot uploaded to RW-452 comment (staging): ks-policy-staging-2026-03-15.json. One caveat: infra scheduled a key rotation Thu 03:00 UTC which might affect test windows. Left a note on RW-452.

nicole_crypto: I’ll take HSM attestation (nicole). I need a couple of items: PKI cert expiry list for keys used by HSM, and HSM firmware + slot info. Can someone run a quick inventory dump or point me to the latest report?

infra-bot: Scheduled rotation notice: KMS key rotation for project/redwood-staging scheduled Thu 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC. Impact: short-lived key swaps; tests may fail for ~2–5m if not retried.

alex_sre: Noted on rotation — I’ll coordinate a small canary run after rotation and add a retry backoff in the backfill script. Will also include a note in the runbook to pin to previous key version if we need immediate rollback.

maya_sec: OK — summarizing owners and timeline for auditors: ingest/backfill = alex_sre, manifest/test coord = sam_platform, PM/approval = lina_pm, HSM attestation = nicole_crypto. Timeline: backfill Wed EOD, attestation Thurs EOD, evidence bundle Fri AM. If anyone can’t hit these, flag here now so we can reassign.

alex_sre: I’ll hit Wed EOD.

sam_platform: On it, should be attached within the hour.

nicole_crypto: Thurs EOD works, will request cert/firmware dump in RW-452 thread.

lina_pm: Confirmed — I’ll sign off once alex posts PR and sam attaches manifest.

maya_sec: Thanks all — I’ll update the evidence matrix and notify auditors of the owners.
